data.name: Aabshar
data.gender_notes: Aabshar is used predominantly as a female name in Persian and Urdu naming tradition.
data.long_meaning: Aabshar (آبشار) is a Persian name meaning “Waterfall; cascade; falling water”. It is a Persian compound of āb (آب) 'water' and shār (شار), from the verb shāridan 'to flow, to trickle' — hence 'where water flows down'. In Persian and Urdu ābshār is the ordinary word for a waterfall or cascade.
